title: This book hides a picture in its edges
hook: Fan the pages slightly, and a landscape appears in the gilt edge
summary: Some books hide paintings on their page edges. Fanning the pages reveals them, and some books show a different picture in each direction.

text: With the book closed, the edge looks golden. Fan the pages slightly, and a picture appears.
It's a book-decorating technique. The pages are fanned and held in place so their exposed edges can be painted.

panels.text: Not inside the book. Along its side?

text: Closing and fanning the pages exposes different surfaces. Gilding can help conceal the hidden picture.
A volume of Shakespeare's plays with this decoration survives. The photo shows another book using the technique.
Some books hide two pictures. Fan the pages one way for one scene, and the other way for another.

panels.text: Guess I'll have to read this one sideways, too.
